extensionDescription.message: Interactive dual subtitles and instant dictionary lookups for language learning on your favorite streaming sites.

helpWatchingBody.message: Open the side panel on Prime Video, YouTube, Netflix, or Disney Plus. Hulu and Max are experimental. Subtitles, tokenization, and translation load as needed.

helpSupportedServicesBody.message: Prime Video, YouTube, Netflix, and Disney Plus are supported. Other services may work experimentally.

helpWordLookupBody.message: Click a word to look it up, save it, hear it, or open its dictionary entry in Language Player.

helpReadingBody.message: Use Page Translation on an ordinary web page. The extension translates readable blocks progressively without changing the page unless you enable interactivity.

helpInteractivityBody.message: Enable interactivity when you want clickable words and phonetics on the page. It remains opt-in.

helpPageDictionaryBody.message: Click an interactive word to open its dictionary details in the side panel.

helpSettingsBody.message: Open Settings from the profile menu. Changes apply immediately and persist between side-panel openings.

helpDisplayControlsBody.message: Choose a theme, text size, translation size, leading, typeface, phonetics mode, and whether to show difficult-word phonetics.

helpAccountBody.message: Use the profile menu to log in, view your level and subscription, open activities, or log out.

helpProfileBody.message: Your profile shows your name, email, learning level, and subscription status. Web-only actions open Language Player.

helpDeletionBody.message: Account deletion requires typing DELETE. Active auto-renewing monthly or annual subscriptions must be cancelled first.

aboutDescription.message: Learn languages with interactive subtitles, page translation, and instant dictionary lookups.

explainWord.message: Please succinctly explain the $l2Name$ word "$word$", then give 2 examples with translations.

explainWordContext.message: Please succinctly explain the $l2Name$ word "$word$" in "$context$", then give 2 examples with translations.

explainWordContextForm.message: Please succinctly explain the $l2Name$ word "$word$" (inflected form: $contextForm$) in "$context$", then give 2 examples with translations.

explainMorphology.message: Give its pronunciation. If it is an inflected or conjugated form, state its dictionary form and explain the inflection. If it is not inflected, do not mention inflection or lemma.

followupInflection.message: Please explain the lemma (dictionary form) of the $l2Name$ word "$word$", how the word is inflecting, and the meaning of the inflected form.

followupInflectionContext.message: Please explain the lemma (dictionary form) of the $l2Name$ word "$word$", how the word is inflecting in "$context$", and the meaning of the inflected form.

followupInflectionContextForm.message: Please explain the lemma (dictionary form) of the $l2Name$ word "$word$" (inflected form: $contextForm$), how the word is inflecting in "$context$", and the meaning of the inflected form.

followupMorphemes.message: Please explain whether the $l2Name$ word "$word$" can be broken down into semantic parts (morphemes), and note any literal interpretations of the word.

followupMorphemesContext.message: Please explain whether the $l2Name$ word "$word$" in "$context$" can be broken down into semantic parts (morphemes), and note any literal interpretations of the word.

followupEtymology.message: Please give the etymology of the $l2Name$ word "$word$".

followupSyntax.message: Please explain whether the $l2Name$ word "$word$" is functioning as a syntactic element, and explain what the syntactical structure is (e.g. sentence structure, part of a phrase, a certain grammatical phenomenon, etc).

followupSyntaxContext.message: Please explain whether the $l2Name$ word "$word$" in "$context$" is functioning as a syntactic element, and explain what the syntactical structure is (e.g. sentence structure, part of a phrase, a certain grammatical phenomenon, etc).

followupSynonyms.message: List up to three synonyms of the $l2Name$ word "$word$" (not the word itself). For each, briefly explain how it differs from "$word$" in meaning or use. If you include pronunciation, put it inline — never on a separate line. No tables or any other content.

followupSynonymsContext.message: List up to three synonyms of the $l2Name$ word "$word$" in "$context$" (not the word itself). For each, briefly explain how it differs from "$word$" in meaning or use. If you include pronunciation, put it inline — never on a separate line. No tables or any other content.

followupSynonymsExamples.message: For each synonym, include one natural example sentence in $l2Name$ and its translation in the learner's UI language. Keep each synonym's explanation, example sentence, and translation together. No tables.

subsAiExamples.message: You are a language-learning assistant. Below are subtitle lines from $n$ videos, each in $l2Name$, that contain the term "$term$". Lines marked with a leading * are the matched lines.
